description: What a Great American Weekend in Goshen! It was wonderful spending time with the Orange County Republican Committee, the Orange County Young Republicans, Orange County Sheriff Paul Arteta, and Attorney General candidate Saritha Komatireddy while meeting so many residents and local businesses from across the district. Events like this are a reminder of what makes the Hudson Valley such a special place to call home. Thank you to everyone who stopped by to say hello, share their concerns, and talk about the future of our communities. I’m grateful for the warm welcome and look forward to continuing to meet voters across NY-18 as we build a stronger, more affordable future for the Hudson Valley. 🇺🇸
